confirmed.what: [Vision] keyword does not trigger on play
confirmed.expected: When played, a triggered ability should go on the chain (or a pendingChoice should appear) letting the player look at the top card of Main Deck and choose whether to recycle it
confirmed.observed: After playUnit resolved: chain=None, pendingChoice=null, moves list immediately offered endTurn/playUnit with no Vision prompt or reveal
confirmed.reason: toTriggerableAbilities (trigger-runner.ts:79-95) only converts abilities where `a.type === "triggered"` (line 80) into TriggerableAbility entries; it silently drops `type: "keyword"` abilities. Card ogn-086-298 (jeweled-colossus.ts:4-16) has no `abilities` field, so enrichCard parses its rulesText and emits `{type: "keyword", keyword: "Vision", effect: {...}}` (parser behavior asserted at parser/__tests__/keywords/vision.test.ts:20-25; same shape in data/sets/ogn.json:3145-3157). ven-173-166 goes through adaptJsonCard→enrichCard and yields the same `type: "keyword"` shape. When playUnit fires the `play-self` event (game-definition/moves/cards.ts:559-562), fireTriggers→getBoardCards→toTriggerableAbilities returns [] for these cards, findMatchingTriggers (trigger-matcher.ts:298-301 also gates on `ability.type !== "triggered"`) matches nothing, and fireTriggers returns 0 at trigger-runner.ts:296-298 without opening a chain or pendingChoice. No code anywhere in the engine expands `{type:"keyword", keyword:"Vision"}` into a `{type:"triggered", trigger:{event:"play-self"}}` ability (grep of engine src for "keyword"-type handling turns up only combat/Deflect/hasKeyword paths; keyword-effects.ts:164-171 is metadata only). Result: playing a Vision unit produces no chain item and no reveal/recycle prompt — matching the observed behavior.

confirmed.what: [Temporary] does not kill Sprite at start of controller's Beginning Phase
confirmed.expected: After ending turn 1 and cycling back to player-1's Beginning Phase (turn 3), Sprite should be moved to trash before scoring (rule 728.1.b)
confirmed.observed: Turn 3 main phase reached with Sprite still in base (readied, exhausted=false) and trash=0. Parsed abilities include {type:'keyword',keyword:'Temporary'} so hasKeyword should match, but the beginning-phase Temporary sweep in riftbound-flow.ts did not remove it.
confirmed.reason: Reproduced end-to-end against the live server: tutored ogn-274-298 into P1 hand, playUnit → base, endTurn P1, endTurn P2 → turn 3 main phase reached with Sprite still at zones/base[0] and never in trash. Root cause is NOT in riftbound-flow.ts (its sweep at lines 246-284 is correct and hasKeyword("…","Temporary") returns true for the abilities-only form). The sweep never fires because finalizePregame() (server.ts:1188-1193) patches state directly to status=playing/phase=main without ever transitioning the FlowManager out of the `setup` segment; every subsequent endTurn's flow.endPhase() therefore transitions inside setup.setupPhase and never runs mainGame's beginning.onBegin (server log confirms: "Flow state mismatch after endTurn … Patching state as safety net" on every turn). The server's manual beginning-phase reimplementation in finalizeEndTurn() (server.ts:1342-1352) does Hold scoring only and omits the rule-728.1.b Temporary kill. Layer is server, not engine.

confirmed.what: 'When you play me, ready another friendly Mech' readies Bubble Bot itself instead of another Mech
confirmed.expected: With an exhausted friendly Mech (Forecaster) in base, the trigger should prompt for / auto-select Forecaster and ready it (excludeSelf:true on the parsed target); Bubble Bot should remain exhausted.
confirmed.observed: Trigger goes on chain with effect {type:'ready', target:{…filter:{tag:'Mech'},excludeSelf:true}} but no targets are attached and no target-selection prompt appears. On resolve, effect-executor.ts:490 falls back to `[ctx.sourceCardId]` when getTargetIds() returns [], so Bubble Bot readies itself (exhausted True→False) and Forecaster stays exhausted.
confirmed.reason: Bubble Bot's rulesText is parsed at load time (enrich-cards.ts:20-38) into a triggered ability whose effect is {type:"ready", target:{type:"unit", controller:"friendly", filter:{tag:"Mech"}, excludeSelf:true}} (verified by running parseAbilities). fireTriggers places it on the chain with no bound targets (trigger-runner.ts:306-321). On resolve, executeResolvedItem (chain-moves.ts:189-222) enumerates candidates via resolveTarget; matchesFilter's tag branch (target-resolver.ts:258-261) reads def.tags from the engine registry, but makeLookupPayload (server.ts:720-742) never forwards tags (and forecaster.ts has no tags field), so options = [] — no choose-target prompt is raised and boundTargets is set to []. executeEffect's "ready" case then falls back to [ctx.sourceCardId] when getTargetIds returns [], readying Bubble Bot itself and leaving Forecaster exhausted.

confirmed.what: Cost reduction per Bird/Cat/Dog/Poro tag not applied
confirmed.expected: With Plundering Poro (a Poro) in play, Daisy! should cost 8 instead of 9
confirmed.observed: Hand cost still displayed 9 and playing Daisy! spent 9 energy (17→8). enrichCards output shows only one parsed ability ({type:'static',effect:{type:'enter-ready'}}); the 'Reduce my cost by [1] for each of the following tags…' sentence and the 'When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun] an enemy unit here' sentence are not parsed into abilities at all.
confirmed.reason: Reproduced: running parseAbilities on Daisy!'s rulesText yields only [{type:'static',effect:{type:'enter-ready',target:'self'}}]. The card def (/root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/daisy.ts:4-16) has no hand-authored `abilities`, so enrichCard (enrich-cards.ts:20-38) parses rulesText. The static-parser cost-reduction section (static-parser.ts:788-912) only matches "I cost X less…", "This spell's Energy cost is reduced by…", and "While/If … cost … less" — there is no regex for "Reduce my cost by [N] for each of the following tags among your units — …", nor a triggered pattern for "When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun]…". Both sentences fall through unparsed, so no cost-reduction ability is attached and the engine charges the printed 9.

confirmed.what: Might filter is per-unit not aggregate
confirmed.expected: Target selection should enforce 'total Might of 8 or less' across all chosen units
confirmed.observed: Chain effect shows filter [{might:{lte:8}}] which caps each individual unit at ≤8 might; no aggregate/totalMight constraint
confirmed.reason: Card def uses per-unit filter `{ might: { lte: 8 } }` (tricksy-tentacles.ts:25), and the engine evaluates `might` filters per-unit against `effectiveMight(def, meta)` (target-resolver.ts:249-251). No aggregate/totalMight filter key exists in the engine — the FIXME comment at tricksy-tentacles.ts:16-18 admits this, yet the code doesn't even use the proposed `totalMight` key, just plain `might`. Result: each chosen unit is individually capped at ≤8 Might instead of the sum being capped at ≤8, contradicting the rules text "total Might of 8 or less".

confirmed.what: Destination restricted to battlefields only
confirmed.expected: rulesText says 'to a single location' — should include bases
confirmed.observed: Chain effect has to:{battlefield:'any'}, excluding bases as a destination
confirmed.reason: Card def line 30 sets `to: { battlefield: "any" }`. Per riftbound-target-dsl.ts:66-68 that is a BattlefieldLocation (battlefields only). Rules text (line 48) says "to a single location", and rule 198.1 states "Locations include the Battlefields and the Bases" (also 107.1.b "Each Base is a Location"). The engine's `to: "choose"` path (effect-executor.ts:549-566) is what offers base + battlefields; `{battlefield:"any"}` excludes bases. So the destination is incorrectly restricted to battlefields, omitting bases as a valid move destination.

confirmed.what: Source location restricted to battlefields

confirmed.what: On-play trigger does nothing
confirmed.expected: Banish hand (5 cards) and trash, then Burn 7 (mill 7 from deck to trash)

Verified at runtime: parseAbilities returns a single {type:"triggered", trigger:{event:"play-self"}, effect:{type:"raw", text:"banish your hand and trash, then [Burn 7]...\n..."}} — the parser cannot decode the effect body and falls through to the raw-stub path. executeEffect (effect-executor.ts:1316-1318) has `default: { break; }`, so type "raw" resolves as a no-op. Net result: on-play trigger goes on the chain and resolves with zero state change — hand 5, banishment 0, trash 0, mainDeck 35, exactly as reported. confirmed.what: 'Skip your Draw Phase' not applied
confirmed.expected: Player-1 should not draw at start of turn 3
confirmed.observed: Hand went 5→6 at start of turn 3; draw phase not skipped
confirmed.reason: ven-022-166 (Endless Riches) has "abilities": [null] in ven.json — the "Skip your Draw Phase" static ability is unparsed/unimplemented. No TS override exists. The Draw Phase onBegin unconditionally calls context.zones.drawCards({count: 1, ...}) with no check for any skip-phase effect from cards in play, and no skipPhase/skipDraw ability type exists anywhere in the engine or cards packages. Hand correctly goes 5→6 because nothing suppresses the draw.

confirmed.what: Unit-swap effect entirely missing
confirmed.expected: Prompt to choose two controlled units at different locations; if one has [Temporary], swap their locations
confirmed.observed: Chain effect is only {type:'draw', amount:1}; no target prompt, no pendingChoice, no move effect
confirmed.reason: smoke-and-mirrors.ts:4-16 declares no `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:20-38 falls through to parseAbilities(rulesText). Runtime check (getAllCards().find(id==='unl-083-219').abilities) yields [{keyword:'Hidden'}, {type:'spell', timing:'action', effect:{type:'draw', amount:1}}] — the parser drops the "Choose a unit… move each to the other's location" clause and keeps only "Draw 1". cards.ts:927-928 then finds that spell ability and pushes effect={type:'draw',amount:1} onto the chain. No target selector, no pendingChoice, no move/swap effect is emitted, matching the Observed claim exactly.

confirmed.what: '3 Might or less' target restriction missing
confirmed.expected: Only units with ≤3 Might at a battlefield should be valid targets
confirmed.observed: Chain effect target is {type:'unit', location:'battlefield'} with no might filter; card def has no abilities so restriction is auto-parsed and drops the might clause
confirmed.reason: soul-harvest.ts:4-15 declares no `abilities`, so enrich-cards.ts:22-29 auto-parses rulesText. The kill-effect regex at parser/index.ts:698 matches the "with 3 [Might] or less" suffix in a NON-capturing group `(?:\s+with\s+.+)?`, so richMatch[1] is only "a unit at a battlefield"; parseCardTarget (index.ts:397-465) has no might-threshold handling. Running parseAbilities on the exact rulesText yields target `{type:"unit",location:"battlefield"}` with no filter. target-resolver.ts:144 only restricts by might when `target.filter` is present, so any battlefield unit is a legal target regardless of Might.

confirmed.what: 'channel 1 rune exhausted' places rune in wrong zone
confirmed.expected: One rune moved from runeDeck to runePool, entering exhausted
confirmed.observed: Rune player-1-rune-3-ogn-089-298 was drawn from runeDeck (10→9) but placed in the 'base' zone instead of 'runePool'; UI renders it floating on the board; runePool stayed at 2/2
confirmed.reason: The "channel" effect handler at effect-executor.ts:471-486 moves the drawn rune to targetZoneId: "base" (line 481) instead of "runePool". The correct behavior is documented in riftbound-flow.ts:363-368 ("Channeled runes go to the runePool zone (not base...)") and resources.ts:57-59 (from runeDeck → to runePool). The handler also ignores effect.exhausted, so it neither places the rune in the correct zone nor marks it exhausted. ogn-047-298's rulesText "channel 1 rune exhausted" parses to {amount:1, exhausted:true, type:"channel"} (parser/index.ts:310-322), which routes to this buggy handler.

confirmed.what: Conditional cost reduction unimplemented
confirmed.expected: Card def should carry a cost-modifier ability for 'if opponent within 3 of Victory Score, costs [2] less'
confirmed.observed: Card def has no abilities field; no cost-modifier logic present (paid full 3 with opponent at 0/8, which is correct for this state but reduction cannot fire in any state)
confirmed.reason: Card def at find-your-center.ts:4-16 has no `abilities` field (only energyCost:3 + rulesText). Registry getAbilities (card-lookup.ts:162-164) therefore returns []. Cost computation (cards.ts:230-236 canAffordCard, 280-285 deductCost) derives adjusted energy solely from base energyCost + meta.costModifier - interactiveReduction + x + repeatSurcharge; there is no read of a self-static cost-reduction ability and no score-within gate on the cost path. computeStaticCostReduction (static-cost-reduction.ts:117-140) scans board permanents only and skips the played card at :138. The engine does have a `score-within` condition evaluator (effect-executor.ts:265-277) but it is only reachable from effect resolution, not cost deduction, and the card has no ability referencing it. The parsed JSON (ogn.json) carries a static ability but with effect {type:"sequence", effects:[]} — no cost-reduction effect — and the engine registry is populated from the TS defs (all-cards.ts:67), not the JSON. Net: the "[2] less if opponent within 3 of Victory Score" reduction cannot fire in any state.

confirmed.what: End-of-turn trigger not implemented
confirmed.expected: At end of turn with Sona at a battlefield, prompt to ready up to 4 friendly runes
confirmed.observed: Card def has no abilities field; no trigger/chain/pendingChoice appeared when attempting to end turn
confirmed.reason: sona-harmonious.ts:4-17 defines the card with rulesText only and no `abilities` field. Compare dazzling-aurora.ts:17-52 which implements the same "end of your turn" pattern via `abilities: [{ type: "triggered", trigger: { event: "end-of-turn", ... }, effect: ... }]`. Without an abilities entry, the engine has nothing to fire at end-of-turn, so no trigger/chain/pendingChoice for readying runes will appear.

confirmed.what: endTurn unavailable after conquering an uncontested battlefield
confirmed.expected: After showdown resolves, endTurn should be offered again in main phase
confirmed.observed: After passShowdownFocus → conquer, moves list never re-offers endTurn; only startShowdown/resolveFullCombat loop; game stuck in main phase turn 3
confirmed.reason: The non-combat showdown close path in passShowdownFocus (chain-moves.ts:1075-1108) sets bf.controller and awards VP for a sole-occupant conquer but never clears bf.contested / bf.contestedBy. The battlefield was marked contested by standardMove (movement.ts:376-379) when the unit arrived at an empty/uncontrolled battlefield, and endShowdownState (chain-state.ts:468) only pops the showdown stack without touching battlefield flags. Because bf.contested stays true, endTurn's guard at turn.ts:68-72 (and enumerator at :91-94) returns false, so endTurn is never offered. Meanwhile startShowdown re-enumerates the still-contested battlefield (chain-moves.ts:1172), and the follow-on showdown (now treated as combat via isCombat=bf.contested at :1183) sets showdownComplete=true, enabling resolveFullCombat (combat.ts:274) — matching the observed startShowdown/resolveFullCombat cycle instead of endTurn. Sona (ogn-073-298) is a vanilla 4-might champion with no coded abilities, so this is a generic engine bug in the uncontested-conquer path, not card-specific.

confirmed.what: endTurn unavailable after conquer (same as ogn-073)

Result: after conquering an uncontrolled battlefield with no opposing units (movement.ts:376-397 sets contested=true and opens a non-combat showdown), the post-resolution move list is exactly {standardMove, startShowdown (re-enumerated via chain-moves.ts:1172), exhaustRune, recycleRune, concede} with endTurn absent. Card-agnostic engine bug — unl-027-219 and ogn-073 are just units that trigger the uncontrolled-battlefield path.

The condition (678-761) and enumerator (847-950) likewise never check trash for a recyclable unit or enumerate a recycleId param, so no selection prompt is offered and the trash card stays put.

confirmed.what: Mech unit token created without a proper card definition
confirmed.expected: Token with name 'Mech', cardType 'unit', might 3
confirmed.observed: State snapshot shows cardType:'unknown', name is the raw instance id 'token-mech-1785898466499-0', no might field
confirmed.reason: Assembly Rig's create-token effect (effect-executor.ts:886-896) registers the Mech token definition in the engine's runtime getGlobalCardRegistry(), and chain-moves.ts:100 sets the card instance's definitionId to the raw instance id (token-mech-{Date.now()}-{i}). But the state snapshot builder at server.ts:114 uses the static @tcg/riftbound-cards getCardRegistry() Map (printed cards only), so server.ts:651 registry.get(cardInstance.definitionId) returns undefined for the token. The fallbacks at server.ts:661/668/669 then emit cardType:'unknown', might:undefined, and name=cardId — exactly the observed snapshot.

But the snapshot builder at server.ts:651 looks up defs via the module-level `registry` = getCardRegistry() from @tcg/riftbound-cards (server.ts:114) — the static printed-card Map — not the engine's global registry. The token id is absent there, so def=undefined → cardType:"unknown" (server.ts:661), name:cardId (server.ts:669), might:undefined (server.ts:668). renderer.js:681-686 fails the /card-image/ load and shows the fallback: name "token-mech-1785898466499-0" + cardType "unknown", which gameplay.css:403 uppercases to "UNKNOWN", with no might badge.

confirmed.what: [Repeat] [2] additional-cost option not offered
confirmed.expected: Prompt (or move variant) to pay [2] extra to repeat the effect when casting
confirmed.observed: playSpell move had no repeat/additional-cost param; no pendingChoice; spell went to chain with a single effect
confirmed.reason: doubleTrouble (unl-032-219) is defined with no `abilities` array (lines 4-16), so CardDefinitionRegistry.getSpellRepeatCost (card-lookup.ts:186-199) returns undefined at the `!def?.abilities` guard (line 188) and getAbilities returns []. Consequently playSpell.condition rejects any repeatCount>0 (cards.ts:744-749) and the reducer stores a single (empty) effect. Contrast curtain-call.ts:50 which carries `repeat: { energy: 1 }` on its spell ability. Additionally the playSpell enumerator result type is `{playerId; cardId; targets?}[]` (cards.ts:847) and never emits a repeatCount variant, and neither server.ts nor public/js/gameplay/ ever sets repeatCount — so no path offers the [2] additional-cost option.

confirmed.reason: Double Trouble (unl-032-219) defines no `abilities` array (double-trouble.ts:4-16 — only metadata + rulesText). At play time, cards.ts:925-928 does `registry.getAbilities(cardId)` → `[]` (card-lookup.ts:162-164 reads `definitions.get(cardId)?.abilities ?? []`), so `spellAbility`/`spellEffect` are undefined and the chain entry is pushed with `effect: undefined` (cards.ts:957). At resolve time, chain-moves.ts:161-173 sees `!rawEffect`, re-looks-up abilities, again finds none, and returns silently — no `executeEffect`, no `pendingChoice`, no deck/hand mutation. The engine does support a `"look"` effect (effect-executor.ts:1066); the card simply never wires one. Matches observed: no prompt, deck size 35, top card unchanged, hand unchanged, nothing recycled.

confirmed.what: Gear with [Temporary] not killed at start of its controller's Beginning Phase
confirmed.expected: Orb of Regret killed (moved to trash) at start of turn 3 Beginning Phase
confirmed.observed: Orb of Regret still in base on turn 3 main phase; grantedKeywords still shows Temporary; no kill in log
confirmed.reason: The FlowManager never leaves the setup segment: server.ts:1188-1193 patches state to status="playing"/phase="main" instead of calling transitionToPlay, so getCurrentSegment()/getCurrentPhase() stay "setup"/"setupPhase" for the whole game (verified by direct run: after applyPatches + executeMove("endTurn"), FlowManager reports segment=setup phase=setupPhase). Consequently the engine's beginning.onBegin hook (riftbound-flow.ts:246-284, which kills Temporary permanents per rule 728.1.b) and ending.onBegin (riftbound-flow.ts:517-525, which expires turn-scoped grantedKeywords) never fire. All turn-transition work is instead done manually by finalizeEndTurn (server.ts:1300-1396), which reimplements Awaken/Hold-scoring/Channel/Draw but omits the rule-728.1.b Temporary kill (should occur between server.ts:1353 and server.ts:1355, before Hold scoring). Result: after Turn to Dust (unl-070-219) grants {keyword:"Temporary"} to Orb of Regret, the gear is never trashed at its controller's Beginning Phase and grantedKeywords still shows Temporary — matching both observed symptoms. The engine hook itself is correct (unit test with runPhaseHook trashes gear with granted Temporary); the report's "Layer: engine" attribution is wrong — this is a server-layer omission.
